rationale: Read all eleven sections, six table rows, trace and JS snippets. Original get/refund/put code had neither a transaction nor concurrency control despite claiming both. Replace it with explicitly illustrative local transactional APIs, serialized scoped key and request fingerprint under trusted actor context; external provider effects still require their own contract/recovery. Not every transport is at-least-once. Current-state sync needs upsert rather than permanently discarding updates. Safe methods permit incidental effects; responses need not repeat; POST may have reliable idempotency semantics.429 Retry-After is optional and proves no universal no-read/no-write condition. A key on500 alone proves no replay result. Backoff accepts zero delay and names parsed inputs/deadline limits; cursor-only resume is not guaranteed.
